overview.description: The T. Rowe Price Securitized Income ETF (TSCZ) is an exchange-traded fund. The fund's investment portfolio concentrates primarily on broad credit fixed income. TSCZ is an actively managed ETF that invests primarily in securitized assets, including residential and commercial mortgage-backed securities, asset-backed securities, and collateralized loan obligations TSCZ was launched on Sep 2, 2026 and is issued by T. Rowe Price.
